# Candidate yogas and Kuja conventions (computed; named definitions, candidates only - not results)
Each line: definition id | holds? | details | source | how often the condition holds in random charts.
- [GK-BPHS36] Gajakesari, strict: Jupiter in a kendra from the lagna or the Moon, joined or aspected by a benefic, not debilitated, combust or in an enemy's sign: does not hold. kendra from lagna no, from Moon no; benefic contact none; debilitated no; enemy's sign yes; combust no. Source: BPHS 36.3-4, source map BPHS_part3.md §5 (BPHS ch. 34-38), not page-checked. Base rate 9%.
- [KESARI-LOOSE] Kesari (loose 'Gajakesari'): Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon: does not hold. Jupiter M8. Source: Phaladeepika VI.14 per the BPHS translator (only 'Kesari'); called Gajakesari by CRUX p28-30 and HJH1 p118 - source map BPHS_part3.md, not page-checked. Base rate 34%.
- [KEM-BARE] Kemadruma (Varahamihira): no planet other than the Sun (nodes not counted) in the 2nd or 12th from the Moon: does not hold. 2nd/12th from the Moon: Ma,Me,Sa. Source: Brihat Jataka XIII (p175-178), source map BJ.md, not page-checked; Varahamihira rejects the other schools' versions. Base rate 45%.
- [KEM-BPHS] Kemadruma (BPHS 37.11-13): besides the 2nd/12th, no planet but the Sun with the Moon or in a kendra from the lagna - the Moon itself in a kendra counts (LOL p322; Garga/Parasara via BJ): does not hold. 2nd/12th occupied. Source: BPHS p398 (ch. 37 sl. 11-13), source map BPHS_part3.md §5 (BPHS ch. 34-38), not page-checked. Base rate 3%.
- [PMP-Ve-BPHS] Malavya (Pancha Mahapurusha): Venus own/exalted in a kendra from the lagna: HOLDS. Venus H1; BPHS gives no cancellation in this chapter. Source: BPHS ch. 75, source map BPHS_part6.md §5.1, not page-checked. Base rate 34%.
- [PMP-Ve-LOL] Malavya, LOL variant: kendra or kona from the lagna: HOLDS. Venus H1. Source: Phaladeepika VI.2-4 as given in LOL p311 (kendra or kona; BPHS ch. 75: kendra only), source map LOL.md, not page-checked. Base rate 48%.
- [PMP-Sa-BPHS] Sasa (Pancha Mahapurusha): Saturn own/exalted in a kendra from the lagna: does not hold. Saturn H12; BPHS gives no cancellation in this chapter. Source: BPHS ch. 75, source map BPHS_part6.md §5.1, not page-checked. Base rate 34%.
- [PMP-Sa-LOL] Sasa, LOL variant: kendra or kona from the lagna: does not hold. Saturn H12. Source: Phaladeepika VI.2-4 as given in LOL p311 (kendra or kona; BPHS ch. 75: kendra only), source map LOL.md, not page-checked. Base rate 48%.
- [RAJA-KKP-Mo] trinal lord Moon placed in an angle (BPHS 34.11-12): HOLDS. Moon owns H5, in H1. Source: BPHS p356-358 (ch. 34 sl. 11-15), source map BPHS_part3.md §5 (BPHS ch. 34-38), not page-checked; PD XX.45 (p245) source map PD_part1.md, not page-checked. Base rate 61%.
- [KUJA-BPHS80] BPHS 80.47-49: Mars 12/4/7/8 from the lagna; a benefic aspect or association cancels: does not hold. Mars H12; cancelled by Ju; the 'partner has the same yoga' clause needs both charts. Source: source map BPHS_part6.md (BPHS p955), not page-checked. Base rate 15%.
- [KUJA-POPULAR] popular rule (LOL: 'not in any authoritative text'): Mars 1/2/4/7/8/12 from lagna, Moon or Venus: HOLDS. Mars from lagna 12, Moon 12, Venus 12; meets it from lagna, Moon, Venus; the partner and age (about 28-30) exceptions need more than this chart. Source: LOL p329-331, source map LOL.md, not page-checked. Base rate 88%.
- [KUJA-PD11.3] Phaladeepika XI.3: Mars in the 7th, or the 7th sign and its navamsa both Mars's: does not hold. Mars H12; 7th sign Virgo, descendant navamsa Gemini. Source: PD p141-142 (XI.3), source map PD_part1.md, not page-checked. Base rate 10%.
